design: Broad muscular middle-aged gate guard. Tawny ochre hide with charcoal leopard mottling. Broad uncovered domed brow, two large ivory upper mandibular tusks, thick shoulder-length dreadlocks with three bronze cuffs. Broad asymmetric overlapping bronze-edged black breastplate; huge rounded single left pauldron, right upper arm bare; three split charcoal leather skirt panels; wrapped shins. Long straight dark combistick held upright in right hand close to body; left hand rests on utility belt with two handcuff loops. Relaxed wide sentry stance.
